mapper.select: SELECT u.user_no, u.username, u.password_hash, u.display_name, u.use_yn, u.failed_attempts, u.locked_until, u.last_login_at, u.must_change_password, r.code AS role_code FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_user_role ur ON ur.user_no = u.user_no LEFT JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_no = ur.role_no WHERE u.username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_user ( username, password_hash, display_name, use_yn, must_change_password ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{useYn}, #{mustChangePassword} )
INSERT INTO tb_user_role (user_no, role_no) SELECT #{userId}, role_no FROM tb_role WHERE code = #{roleCode} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_user SET failed_attempts = 0, locked_until = NULL, last_login_at = NOW(), lst_chg_dt = NOW() WHERE username = #{username}
UPDATE tb_user SET failed_attempts = failed_attempts + 1, lst_chg_dt = NOW() WHERE username = #{username}
UPDATE tb_user SET locked_until = NOW() + (#{lockMinutes} * INTERVAL '1 minute'), lst_chg_dt = NOW() WHERE username = #{username}
